events.name: VIEW
events.description: Signals an item has been selected for viewing.

events.name: GalleryItemLoaded
events.description: Indicates a GalleryItem has finished loading.

events.name: GalleryItemLoadFailed
events.description: Indicates a GalleryItem failed to load.

events.name: REFETCH_QUERY
events.description: Triggers a gallery refresh based on the current search query.

events.name: REFETCH_FILTER
events.description: Triggers a gallery refresh based on current filter criteria.

events.name: CLOSE
events.description: Indicates the gallery or lightbox has been dismissed.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Show the gallery's own search box?
overridableConfigKeys.description: Embeds a search box above the gallery grid. Set false (the default) when the page already provides a search affordance (a toolbar Search molecule), so the surface shows one search box instead of two.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: inline search, list search, built-in search, show search, duplicate search

overridableConfigKeys.label: Filter bar look
overridableConfigKeys.description: Visual treatment for the embedded filter bar, mirroring std-filter's own enum. Only applies when `filters` is non-empty.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: filter bar style, facet style, chips, pills

overridableConfigKeys.label: Which filters should appear above the gallery?
overridableConfigKeys.description: Dropdown filter facets by field, rendered as an embedded filter bar above the grid; each selection fires REFETCH_FILTER on this trait. Empty (the default) = no filter bar, which is the right setting whenever the page already composes std-filter beside this gallery and routes `XFilter.FILTER -> REFETCH_FILTER` — that is the wired owner and remains the primary path. Use this knob only for a standalone gallery with no page-level filter affordance.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: filter bar, faceted filters, field filters, dropdowns

overridableConfigKeys.label: Image field
overridableConfigKeys.description: Entity field holding the image URL shown in the lightbox for the selected item
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: image url field, thumbnail field, src field

overridableConfigKeys.label: Name field
overridableConfigKeys.description: Entity field providing the lightbox alt text and caption for the selected item

overridableConfigKeys.label: How many images to fetch per page?
overridableConfigKeys.description: Records fetched from the server when REFETCH_PAGE fires (a composed std-pagination driving this trait). The initial load and revisit fetches stay unpaged (whole collection), unchanged from before this knob existed.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: fetch limit, records per page, batch size, page limit

overridableConfigKeys.label: Which column does the search box match against?
overridableConfigKeys.description: Name the field on this entity the search box's str/includes filter matches against. Declared, never inferred: an entity with no `name` column must set this to a real field (e.g. title, caption) or the search box can never match a row.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: search column, search on field, match field, search key

overridableConfigKeys.label: Search box placeholder text
overridableConfigKeys.description: Hint text inside the gallery search box (e.g. 'Search photos…').
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: search hint, placeholder, search box text, search label

overridableConfigKeys.label: Section title
overridableConfigKeys.description: Heading shown above the image gallery
